listing.aiSummary: Provides an English translation for a faction featuring linked ship combat networks and a merit-based exchange system.

description: Translates a faction where ships link into a shared combat network that strengthens as more members join the field. Includes a system for earning War Merit Tokens by destroying hostile ships, which can be spent at a Forward Outpost on ships, weapons, colony structures, or a dice board.

Includes a system for earning War Merit Tokens by destroying hostile ships, which can be spent at a Forward Outpost on ships, weapons, colony structures, or a dice board.
discordPostHtml:
Hello this is a full translation for the Tiangong United Ship Design Bureau ready for us English users! 🎉

  • Myriad Machines Linkage Core: Tiangong ships don't fight alone. Fleet members link into a shared combat network, and the more of them on the field, the stronger they all get.
  • The Tiangong United Exchange: Destroy hostile ships to earn War Merit Tokens, then spend them at the Forward Outpost on ships, weapons, colony structures… or test your luck on the dice board.
  • And a few secrets

Requirements

  • LazyLib, MagicLib, GraphicsLib, LunaLib, BoxUtil

Original mod by kickis
